data.body:
Hello Mesa Electrical Field Services,

Please carry out work order WO-1 on INV-3 (reseat_comms_card).

Steps, in order:
  1. Lockout and tagout the dedicated breaker supplying power to INV-3 per electrical safety procedures
  2. Verify zero energy at the inverter cabinet terminals using a calibrated multimeter
  3. Apply personal protective grounds on the breaker side as required by NFPA 70E
  4. Ensure trained personnel are standing by at the scene for emergency response
  5. De-isolate INV-3 from the grid and lock out/tag out the AC and DC disconnects.
  6. Open the inverter cabinet and visually inspect the communication card for any signs of burns, loose harnesses, or corrosion.
  7. Carefully unplug the fiber and Ethernet cables from the comms card, noting their positions.
  8. Remove the communication card from its slots and reseat it firmly until it clicks into place.
  9. Reconnect all fiber and Ethernet cables to their original ports on the reseated card.
  10. Close the cabinet, restore AC and DC power, and power-cycle INV-3.
  11. Ping the unit from SCADA to verify comms are restored and the display shows live data.
  12. If the display remains dark or ping fails, re-open the cabinet and double-check all cable connections.
  13. Log the repair and update the SCADA asset status to 'online'.
  14. Remove personal protective grounds only after confirming safe conditions
  15. Re-energize the system by closing breaker 52-In supplying INV-3
  16. Restore only the communications task logs after successful verification
  17. Conduct final lockout release only after supervisory sign-off

Do not:
  - Do not attempt to power-cycle the unit before reseating the card, as this may mask a loose connection.
  - Do not force the fiber cables; ensure ends are clean before reinsertion.
  - Do not ignore a persistently dark display after reseating; further hardware replacement may be needed.

We will verify against the plant before closing this order:
  - INV-3 SCADA data_age_min at most 5 and status running
  - INV-3 answers comms_ping (its comms card is back on the network)
  - INV-3 display lit and showing readings in a camera view the verifier picks, not the contractor's photo
  - JEV verdict 'verified' from the registered camera stations and the sensor state

Reply to this email when the work is done.

GridTwin Ops (automated agent team)
